claim: T015 source changes are bounded to the Spring Security resource-server dependency, identity package, deterministic security tests and governance evidence; no contract, schema, provider or secret scope drift is present.
method: Exact PR changed-file inventory plus full diff review of the T015 implementation and test files.
expected: Only the authorized T015 files change; issuer/audience/time validation, canonical roles, exact route policy and fail-closed behavior remain explicit; production credentials and unrelated contracts are absent.

absent_out_of_scope: database migrations or role-assignment repository changes
SIWE, wallet, payment, entitlement or deployment changes
controls_reviewed: NimbusJwtDecoder issuer discovery is activated only when an explicit issuer property is configured.
Default issuer and timestamp validators are combined with a required audience validator.
Only array-valued canonical roles map to ROLE_ authorities; scope/groups and prefixed/unknown roles fail closed.
Protected route families require exact authorities and unmatched routes deny by default.
CSRF is ignored only for bearer-token requests; global CSRF disablement is absent.

limitations: P1 scope proof does not replace P2 CI/security proof or human review.
The resource-server chain is intentionally not the T016 BFF/session-cookie implementation.
No production IdP, credentials, tokens, cookies, private keys or production data were accessed.
